pell_signed_branch_binomial_recovery: Signed Pell estimates and M>=4*b give the exact alternating truncation abs(s)*M=sum_{j=0}^r binomial(2*r,j)*sigma^j*U^(r-j), U=abs(w)*M.
pell_signed_branch_phi_recovery_scope: Only after canonical positive witnesses are reselected does phi=c-(2*r+1)>0 recover the old positive coordinate.
pell_signed_branch_positive_completeness: Every coding-prefix solution can be represented with all thirteen integer inputs positive, so the retained simultaneous integer-interface completeness theorems apply.

pell_signed_branch_predecessor_guard_met.pell_core_equivalence_scope: Existential equivalence with the corrected positive source, retaining every integer predicate; Pell witnesses may be reconstructed.
pell_signed_branch_predecessor_guard_met.pell_halftrace_completeness: For c=Y_B(a), d=X_B(a), B odd, choose the square coordinate 2*X_((B+1)/2)(a).
pell_signed_branch_predecessor_guard_met.pell_halftrace_nonzero_scope: s=0 forces p=a=c=0, k=+/-1, d=+/-1; the new square would equal2, impossible over Q.
pell_signed_branch_predecessor_guard_met.pell_halftrace_sign_scope: For |a|>=2 and |c|>1, the norm and new square force a*d>0.
pell_signed_branch_predecessor_guard_met.pell_power_signed_branches: Auxiliary C=0 and all negative/inverse Pell branches explicitly excluded in the proof
pell_signed_branch_predecessor_guard_met.pell_signed_q_final_recovery: Signed congruences and Q*b^L+1<modulus force q=b^L>0
pell_signed_branch_predecessor_guard_met.signed_binomial_positivity_modulus_hypot: M=n^2 >= 16, automatic from the retained q=b^(5^60), n=q^16 and b>=2
pell_signed_branch_predecessor_guard_met.source_universality_verification_scope: Reduction through the one-quotient binomial certificate to the corrected Jones (1980) Theorem 2 source; its external coding theorem and all integer-interface premises are retained.

pell_signed_branch_projection_scope: Same coding-prefix and instance projection; arbitrary retained signed auxiliary values need not extend to the predecessor. Positive binomial, CRT, power and integer-interface witnesses can be chosen anew.
pell_signed_branch_zero_exclusion: The strengthened margin makes s=0 imply c=power_C=0 and A0-1 divides5^60; the factor (b-1)*H0(b), H0(1)=25 and b>32 give a contradiction modulo125.
